structured_output.plan: Small CNN+MLP fusion regressor for Pawpularity score. Image branch: conv+pool layers reduce [3,256,256] to a feature vector; tabular branch: small MLP on [12] features; concatenate and output scalar via linear head. Synthetic random CPU tensors for batches (no file I/O), MSE loss, Adam optimizer. CandidateAdapter has no-arg constructor and implements build_model, build_optimizer, build_train_batch, build_validation_batch, training_step, validation_step. Main guard runs one train and one validation step as a smoke test.
